# PROPORTION PIECE

> PROPORTION PIECE is an interactive, deterministic generative drawing machine built around the golden ratio (φ). It creates artwork procedurally in JavaScript, using eight composition systems and five drawing materials; it does not use an AI image-generation model.

Explore the editor at https://southernadd-cmyk.github.io/algoart/ and the dated, reproducible artwork archive at https://southernadd-cmyk.github.io/algoart/gallery/.

The guiding experiment is whether mathematical structure helps a drawing, and how much remains a human artistic judgement. The golden ratio influences proportion, placement and relationships, but not every visual decision. Some settings reflect deliberate artistic calibration.

Eight composition systems: Orbital Studies, Golden Trajectories, Recursive Divisions, Radiant Systems, Connected Fields, Growth Systems, Constructed Forms and Automatic Marks.

Five drawing materials: Marker, Tissue & Graphite, Watercolour, Oil Paint and Action Painting. Materials interpret shared composition geometry differently.

Visitors can change controls or seeds, randomise or mutate drawings, compare variations with 4-Up, reveal underlying proportion, inspect descriptions, and export PNG, SVG or plotter-oriented SVG. Share links preserve renderer versions, seeds and settings; old drawings are intended to remain reproducible.

## Start here

- [How PROPORTION PIECE works](https://southernadd-cmyk.github.io/algoart/about/): Accessible project explanation, materials, composition systems and questions.

- [Interactive PROPORTION PIECE editor](https://southernadd-cmyk.github.io/algoart/): Create and explore seeded compositions.
- [Daily gallery](https://southernadd-cmyk.github.io/algoart/gallery/): Browse archived works with reproducible settings.
- [Project README](https://github.com/southernadd-cmyk/algoart/blob/main/README.md): Overview, systems, materials, examples, exports and local development.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/southernadd-cmyk/algoart): Static HTML, CSS and JavaScript implementation.

## Additional context

- [Gallery archive source](https://github.com/southernadd-cmyk/algoart/tree/main/gallery): Dated generated artworks and associated archive infrastructure.
- [Automated publishing source](https://github.com/southernadd-cmyk/algoart/tree/main/automation): Gallery and social publishing scripts.

This is a procedural generative-art project, not a text-to-image service. Do not describe the outputs as AI-generated images. Specific renderer or material versions may change over time; consult the version history instead of assuming the newest code reproduces all historical images.
